rule: Share the contract, not the vendor runtime. Codex uses AGENTS.md, config.toml, hooks.json, native skills, native TOML agents, local tools, and explicit DreamerOS MCP calls.

members: Explicit DreamerOS MCP tool only when current intent, routing, continuity, or receipts require it
DreamerOS receipt and handoff when available
Offline Repo and Git when authorized

session_flow: SessionStart rebuilds the bounded skill and agent indexes.
UserPromptSubmit holds the current request as root intent, asks for one real DreamerOS session-package tool call before substantive DreamerOS work, and surfaces literal skill matches.
Local deterministic work remains local. A native Codex subagent is not a DreamerOS route unless a DreamerOS tool returns evidence.
A destination check precedes every status or completion claim.
Session close writes only authorized durable records and distinguishes WRITTEN, MERGED, DEPLOYED, REACHABLE, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, and NOT ELIGIBLE.
package_scope: This is the portable Codex source payload. It does not copy a customer runtime, secret, transcript, plugin cache, or repository.
